items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His wife still lives here in Los Angeles, Iola Johnson. [INTERVIEWEE] I saw her not too long ago at the Clef Club Christmas party.

ctx.x: Buddy Collette perhaps in the early forties, he was a member of the C.P. Johnson orchestra. Johnson was a bongo player, very flamboyant.
